answer.short:
$840\text{ cm}^3$

Subtract the cut-off triangular prism from the original block.
answer.worked:
The removed prism has a right-triangular cross-section with perpendicular sides $8\div2=4\text{ cm}$ and $6\div2=3\text{ cm}$, and height $20\text{ cm}$.

$$\begin{aligned}V_{\text{original}}&=8\times6\times20=960\text{ cm}^3\\V_{\text{removed}}&=\tfrac12\times4\times3\times20=120\text{ cm}^3\\V_{\text{remaining}}&=960-120=840\text{ cm}^3\end{aligned}$$
